description:
The Office of the Assistant Secretary fo the Air Force for Acquisition, Technology, and Logisitcs (SAF/AQ) and the Air Force District of Washington, Contracting Directorate (AFDW/PK) are publishing this Request for Information (RFI) to support market research efforts for a follow-on for Air Force Technical and Analytic Support in Professional Services (AFTAS PRO). This is an advisory and assistance professional services contract to provide for analysis, development, integration, and implementation of various acquisitions program planning and assessment, and other capabilities to advance the goals and objectives of the Air Force acquisition enterprise.

Please see the attached documents for more information, response guidelines, and draft PWS.

As a general reminder, this SAM.gov post is not a request for quote/bid/proposal. The Government is not responsible or liable for any costs incurred as a result of any work performed in connection with this post. Additionally, this PWS may be substantially revised in any future RFI or potential solicitation.
